_readme: Every text field is {en, zh}. Items with "todo": true are placeholders: they render with a dashed outline and build.py lists them. Run `python3 build.py` after editing.

title.en: Tao-Ting Chen · Autonomous driving and efficient inference
title.zh: 陳道亭 Tao-Ting Chen · 自動駕駛與高效推論

description.en: Ph.D. student at NYCU working on vision-language-action models for autonomous driving and real-time inference.
description.zh: 陽明交通大學博士生，研究自動駕駛的視覺-語言-動作模型與即時推論。

lede.en: Ph.D. student at NYCU. I research vision-language-action models for autonomous driving, with a focus on real-time inference.
lede.zh: 陽明交通大學博士生，研究自動駕駛的視覺-語言-動作（VLA）模型，專注於即時推論。

sim_hint.en: Simplified simulation: at higher latency the model reacts to an older position of the truck.
sim_hint.zh: 簡化模擬：延遲越高，模型依據的卡車位置越舊。

label.en: faster inference on a VLA driving model
label.zh: VLA 駕駛模型推論加速

label.en: per frame on one RTX 5060 Ti
label.zh: 單張 RTX 5060 Ti 每幀延遲
項最佳化實驗完整記錄

body.en: A fine-tuned InternVL2-1B vision-language-action model that drives a truck in Euro Truck Simulator 2 from screen pixels. I profiled each stage of the pipeline and reduced inference latency from 691 ms to 56.9 ms per frame on a single consumer GPU.
body.zh: 以微調後的 InternVL2-1B 視覺-語言-動作模型，直接從螢幕畫面駕駛《歐洲卡車模擬 2》。我逐段分析推論流程，在單張消費級 GPU 上將每幀延遲從 691 ms 降到 56.9 ms。

chart_title.en: Latency per frame after each optimization
chart_title.zh: 各項最佳化後的每幀延遲

note.en: The report also covers the approaches that did not help: INT8 and FP8 quantization, TensorRT, and a dual-GPU setup.
note.zh: 報告也記錄了沒有幫助的方法：INT8 與 FP8 量化、TensorRT，以及雙 GPU 配置。

title.en: IZeroDNAS: Innovative Differentiable NAS Using Zero-Cost Metrics and SuperNet Initialization
title.zh: IZeroDNAS: Innovative Differentiable NAS Using Zero-Cost Metrics and SuperNet Initialization

items.authors: Van-Tin Luu, Tao-Ting Chen, Khanh-Phong Bui, Vu-Hoang Tran, Yung-Hui Li, Ching-Chun Huang
items.venue: APSIPA Transactions on Signal and Information Processing, 15(1), 676–706

title.en: Reducing inference latency of a VLA driving model on a consumer GPU
title.zh: 在消費級 GPU 上降低 VLA 駕駛模型的推論延遲

bio.en: I am a Ph.D. student at the Institute of Computer Science and Engineering, National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University (NYCU), advised by Prof. Ching-Chun Huang.
bio.zh: 我是國立陽明交通大學資訊科學與工程研究所的博士生，指導教授為黃敬群教授。

bio.en: My research is on end-to-end planning for autonomous driving with vision-language-action models, and on making these models fast enough to run in real time on edge hardware.
bio.zh: 我研究以視覺-語言-動作模型進行端到端自動駕駛規劃，以及如何讓這類模型在邊緣裝置上達到即時推論。

body.en: Open to research collaborations and AI/ML engineering roles.
body.zh: 歡迎研究合作與 AI／ML 工程職缺機會。

side._how_to_add: Add a new object at the top of items: title, body (one sentence), stack, year, link. Newest first.

body.en: My entry setup for OpenAI's Parameter Golf challenge: training the best language model that fits in a 16 MB file, with an automated loop that proposes changes to the training script and keeps the ones that improve the score.
body.zh: 參加 OpenAI Parameter Golf 挑戰的實驗環境：在 16 MB 的檔案大小限制內訓練出最好的語言模型，並以自動化流程提出訓練程式的修改、保留有改善的版本。

body.en: Placeholder: one or two sentences on what StreamLens does and the number you are proudest of.
body.zh: 佔位內容：用一兩句話說明 StreamLens 做什麼，以及你最自豪的一個數字。

body.en: A personal research knowledge base maintained by an LLM agent, covering autonomous driving, robotics and 3D reconstruction.
body.zh: 由 LLM 代理維護的個人研究知識庫，涵蓋自動駕駛、機器人與 3D 重建。

body.en: Placeholder: implementations of DDPM and DDIM sampling with FID evaluation. Add your best FID and what you learned.
body.zh: 佔位內容：DDPM 與 DDIM 取樣實作及 FID 評估。請補上最佳 FID 與心得。

body.en: Reads a photographed worksheet, generates the answers, imitates a handwriting style and writes them on paper with a pen held by a modified 3D printer. Runs on a Jetson Nano without the cloud.
body.zh: 讀取題目照片並產生解答，模仿手寫風格後轉成 G-code，由改裝的 3D 列印機握筆寫在紙上。全程在 Jetson Nano 上執行，不依賴雲端。

title.en: AlpaSim E2E Closed-Loop Challenge 2026, PAI track

detail.en: Closed-loop end-to-end driving challenge hosted by NVIDIA, part of the World Models in Physical AI workshop at NeurIPS 2026. 5th on the public leaderboard, which also lists the organizer's own entry. Team ACM_Lab_D_Team.
detail.zh: NVIDIA 主辦的閉迴路端到端自動駕駛挑戰賽，屬於 NeurIPS 2026 的 World Models in Physical AI workshop。公開排行榜含主辦方自己的參考成績，列第 5。隊伍名稱 ACM_Lab_D_Team。
